note: Invented products and invented findings, drawn in the real extension panel (see capture.mjs). Nothing here assesses a real brand.

claims.title: Water gets into the rear footwell
claims.body: Owners of this generation report a damp rear carpet after rain. The usual cause is a blocked drain in the boot channel, and it shows as a water line in the spare-wheel well.
claims.advice: Lift the boot floor and look for a water line or a musty smell.

claims.title: Timing belt due at 6 years or 90,000 km
claims.body: The service schedule calls for a belt change at 6 years or 90,000 km, whichever comes first. A car sold at 7 years with no invoice may be overdue.
claims.advice: Ask for the invoice for the last belt and water-pump change.

claims.title: Dual-clutch judders when pulling away
claims.body: A shudder from a standstill is a common complaint on the automatic version, worst in stop-start traffic.
claims.advice: Drive it in stop-start conditions, not only on a clear road.

claims.title: Screen reboots on cold mornings
claims.body: The infotainment unit restarts a few times after a cold start. A software update stops it.

claims.title: The review tested the 1 TB model, not 256 GB
claims.body: The headline speed comes from a review of the 1 TB version. The 256 GB drive has fewer chips and is slower in the same test lineup.
claims.advice: Look for a test of the 256 GB configuration before trusting the headline speed.

claims.title: Fan ramps up under light load
claims.body: Several owners report the fan spinning up during video calls and browsing, not only under heavy work.
claims.advice: Run a video call for ten minutes and listen.

claims.title: Charging port loosens over time
claims.body: The left charging port works loose after a few months of daily use on some units.
claims.advice: Wiggle the cable gently in each port when you inspect it.

claims.title: Battery claim is for low-brightness video
claims.body: The advertised battery life was measured with video playback at a low screen brightness.

claims.title: Hinge cracks near the swivel
claims.body: A hairline crack appears where the earcup meets the headband after several months of folding them into a bag.
claims.advice: Check the plastic around both swivels in good light.

claims.title: Ear-pad foam flakes after a year
claims.body: The pad covering peels with sweat and warmth. Replacement pads are sold separately.
claims.advice: Ask whether pads are included for replacement and what they cost.

claims.title: Hiss with noise cancelling on early firmware
claims.body: A faint hiss in quiet rooms is fixed by a firmware update released after launch.

claims.title: Pump gets loud and weak after a year
claims.body: Owners report the vibration pump turning noisy and losing pressure after about 12 months of daily use.
claims.advice: Ask for the purchase date and whether the pump has been replaced.

claims.title: Scale builds up fast in hard water
claims.body: The small boiler scales quickly. The manual asks for descaling every four to six weeks in hard-water areas.
claims.advice: Look for white deposits and ask how often it was descaled.

claims.title: Steam wand seal leaks
claims.body: A slow drip from the steam wand appears once the rubber seal hardens, usually after two to three years.
claims.advice: Run the steam wand, then watch for drips when it is off.

claims.title: Drip-tray sensor sticks
claims.body: The float in the drip tray sticks and shows an empty-tank warning while the tank is full.
